maintenance_led.reason: Mostly SendTech installed base of postage meters and mailing systems: support services, supplies, rentals and financing, plus presort services.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private businesses, with some government and university clients such as the Missouri Department of Social Services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own mailing, shipping software and presort business; it is not an acquisition roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Postage meters, mailroom systems and shipping software are embedded in operations and postal-compliant, so switching means retraining and disruption.

notes: Maintenance-led is a judgement call: revenue mixes equipment leasing, supplies and services, and the site gives no revenue split.
